description: Additional one storey (height 2.7m) of development containing 5 flats on an existing detached block of flats - maximum overall height 18.65m (Prior approval of transport and highways impacts; air traffic and defence asset impacts; contamination risks; flooding risks; the external appearance of the building; the provision of adequate natural light in all habitable rooms of the new dwellinghouses; impact on the amenity of the existing building and neighbouring premises and impact on a protected view)
decision_conditions: The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

<p>Prior to first occupation of the development, details of secure, covered and conveniently located cycle parking facilities shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. The cycle parking shall be provided in accordance with the approved details and the minimum cycle parking standards set out in the London Plan and shall be made available prior to first occupation of the development. The approved facilities shall thereafter be retained and maintained for cycle parking purposes for the lifetime of the development.&nbsp;</p>

<p>The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the following approved plans and documents:&nbsp;</p><p>KL/1388-11&nbsp;</p><p>KL/1388-12&nbsp;</p><p>KL/1388-13&nbsp;</p><p>KL/1388-14&nbsp;</p><p>KL/1388-15&nbsp;</p><p>Location Plan&nbsp;</p><p>Block Plan&nbsp;</p><p>PLANNING STATEMENT (Kompass London Design &amp; Build)</p>
The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.
